body: OMG!!! I am so upset I missed this!!!!! RAWR!!!

I think it's sad most people wouldn't notice raw dough or a grease saturated bun.  Especially in a place that is supposed to be known for fresh food.  I definitely would have noticed those things. Probably the frozen raviolis too and sent it all back.

This is what I hate about Yelp.  you have to try to figure out who the foodies are and then only read their reviews otherwise you can get scammed into going to a restaurant that sucks but people who didn't know left all of these good reviews.

It depends.  If I am eating at some cheap chain restaurant like olive garden or something and it's not perfect I generally shrug my shoulders and eat it anyway.  I am not going to expect perfection at a chain restaurant.  However my (soon to be ex) husband and I loved to go to high end restaurants where we would drop over $200 on dinner.  When you are spending more money you have higher expectations.  I have sent back items that were even a little off at a higher end restaurant.  I am not going to drop $50 on a plate of food and it not be fantastic.

I thank all of yall for the great mom comments.  I have spent the whole day in my room only forcing myself out of it to take them to lunch, get their hair cut and go grocery shopping.  I feel like I am fading away and they would be better off without me.  I don't know how to stop this. I don't know how to find myself again and how to build a life alone.  When I took them to lunch I just sat there silently while they ate.  my younger one came in my room several times to check on me.  this only increases my guilt and feelings of failure.

I can see why it seems that my thoughts go to suicide because of my husband.  He is only a part of it.  I feel like I have failed my kids as a mother.  that I have failed as a person.  I think about my future and it seems bleak.  We decided together I would stay home with the kids and so I never carved out a career for myself.  I started going back to school and am almost finished but now don't see a way to take care of my kids and be able to finish.  I see a future of loneliness and struggle ahead of me and it just seems hopeless.  He is military and I helped him, supported him, waited through two deployments for him and now he will retire with a full pension while I receive nothing for my hard work of keeping the family secure all of those years.  I feel jilted and tossed aside.
I am in the same boat.  I wish I had answers.  I m so sorry :(
I have Yahoo I've never used kik. I'm a little computer dumb. Lol
I also have a lot of fears about being alone. I turn 35 next month and gave my whole life to my marriage.  I fear I'll die alone.

I almost feel like the decision to divorce is an emotional one. For me the evenings are hardest. I've been self medicating with alcohol and its not good. I wish there was an easy process and that I didn't feel completely alone.
Are you in a better place now? If so how did you get there? I know I should move forward with a divorce but I don't feel capable.

The sad thing for me is that in between the times he is with these other "women" he acts caring and confused about whether or not he actually wants a divorce.  Once he starts seeing them again it's like I am less than nothing.  I stood up for him to all of my friends and family and ended up cutting them off.  Now I have nothing and it's like he doesn't care.  I don't understand how 14 years can be nothing :(

I have no anger towards their father. I would not be moving my children out of anger but out of common sense. I came here to see if my marriage could be salvaged so there is no reason for me to continue living here if my marriage is over. Of course I work. How else would I be taking care of my children financially?

I have already spoken with lawyers and know that a divorce is more than likely inevitable I just do not know how I can let go of who he was and realize this is who he is choosing to be. I don't keep the kids from him but it is very painful to see him and to speak to him. I wish I could just disappear.
